version.author: ArticulationBox
version.changelog: Manual keyswitch notes coexist with automatic assignments. Later manual or automatic switches trim earlier switches on the same channel.

version.author: ArticulationBox
version.changelog: Add offline Help topics to the full menu. Include detailed English and Russian user guides.

version.author: Andrey Novikov
version.changelog: Include the MIT license in the package and retain third-party notices.

version.author: Andrey Novikov
version.changelog: Keep Save open; support Add New, Add variant and next-entry editing. Learn existing mapping names/settings and refresh row names on every save. Stabilize custom window dragging and use one Delay timing label. Preserve overrides while adding chord notes and repair close switch timing.

version.author: Andrey Novikov
version.changelog: Keep background keyswitch updates in the original MIDI Undo/Redo step. Preserve articulation assignments when notes move or stagger. Save & Next always selects Add New; an unmapped learned key starts a new entry.

version.author: Andrey Novikov
version.changelog: Add independent Controller presets and optional linked articulation controllers. Support Pitch Bend and CC with full-note, note-start and note-end timing. Keep controller movement, boundary room and item tails in MIDI Undo/Redo. Add Reset controllers to ready menus without changing articulations. Fix the Controller type button color stack and Add New selection.
